name: studyflare
description: Studyflare: an AI-assisted study platform on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DB.description: D1 database for your courses, notes and cards. Created automatically.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: **Your email address.** Only these emails (comma-separated) can sign in, and they own this Studyflare.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Keep `todo`. On first open, Studyflare sets up its Cloudflare Access sign-in and fills this in.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Keep `todo`. Filled in by Studyflare's first-run setup.
